strategy_name: Urban Primary Drain Desilting & Channel Widening
description: Routine desilting and widening of municipal primary stormwater drains and micro-canals to restore design discharge capacity.
adaptation_objective: Restore hydraulic carrying capacity and reduce localized urban flood inundation.
applicability_rules: urban_flood_risk >= MEDIUM AND drain_blockage_index = HIGH AND land_availability = HIGH
technical_requirements: Excavation machinery and bathymetric silt profiling
institutional_requirements: GCC / Urban Local Bodies Waterways Cell
effectiveness_basis: Qualitative field observations from past GCC monsoon desilting drives
tradeoffs: Disruption to road traffic during desilting operations
failure_conditions: Severe downstream tidal blockage during high storm surge
implementation_constraints: Encroachment along canal banks and disposal site shortages
success_metrics: Reduction in peak inundation depth and clearing time

description: Subsurface reinforced concrete runoff storage vaults with automated sump pump discharge into primary outflow channels.

strategy_name: Mandatory Rooftop Rainwater Harvesting (RWH) & Injection Shafts
description: Compulsory installation of rooftop collection filters and deep bore recharge shafts across residential and commercial structures.
adaptation_objective: Recharge unconfined aquifers and reduce peak roof runoff discharge during monsoon rainfall events.
applicability_rules: roof_area >= 50 AND groundwater_depletion = HIGH AND hydrogeology_suitable = TRUE
technical_requirements: Basic filtration media and percolation pit maintenance
institutional_requirements: TWAD Board / Municipal Building Approval Authority
effectiveness_basis: Official TN RWH mandate evaluation reports (CGWB/TWAD)
co_benefits: Aquifer water table recovery;Reduced urban sheet flow
tradeoffs: Initial cost for property owners;Filter maintenance burden
negative_impacts: Borehole contamination if first-flush diverter is bypassed
failure_conditions: Lack of filter cleaning leading to siltation of injection shaft
implementation_constraints: Non-compliance by building owners and improper maintenance
monitoring_indicators: Aquifer static water level (m bgl);Recharge volume index
success_metrics: Rise in shallow groundwater level across block

strategy_name: Traditional Temple Tank & Cascade Lake (Eri) De-silting and Restoration
description: Rejuvenation of ancient cascading lake systems (Eris) and temple tanks including silt clearance and inlet supply channel clearing.
adaptation_objective: Restore regional hydrological storage capacity and enhance drought resilience and flood buffering.

technical_requirements: Catchment hydrological mapping and desilting machinery
effectiveness_basis: TNSDMA and WRD tank restoration field impact reports
tradeoffs: Submerged land boundary disputes during bund widening

failure_conditions: Feeder channel encroachment causing tank isolation
success_metrics: Increase in surface water availability and crop yield
